# Bounded PR page scan

list_merged_prs limits scanning to at most 10 pages of 100 PRs each (a hard bound of 1000 PRs per invocation).

Prevent unbounded API pagination and limit resource/time usage during a reconcile.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/forge.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.forge.GitHubGateway.list_merged_prs`
